items.name: SimpleRing
items.description: A Perl CGI script formerly distributed by the original PerlCoders company. It is listed here as a historical reference because inbound links and archived indexes still point at its old URLs. It is not available, not supported, and not recommended for use.

formerPurpose.text: The name and the surrounding catalogue structure suggest a webring script — software that linked a set of participating sites into a browsable circular navigation.
formerPurpose.note: Reconstructed from the product name and legacy URL pattern only. No original documentation has been located. Corrections with a source are welcome.

items.advisoryNote: No advisory has been located in our sources. Absence of a recorded advisory is not evidence that the code was safe — unmaintained 1990s CGI should be treated as unsafe by default.

modernEquivalent.summary: There is no maintained equivalent, and webrings are largely obsolete as a discovery mechanism. If the goal is a curated link circle, a static generated page in a modern framework is the closest safe pattern.
